log.text: Evidence (crashes.mjs -> crashes.json): 336 exit lines in sustain.log 2026-09-26..10-19: 53 x 3221226505, 281 x exit 1, 1 x 4294967295, 1 x 1073807364. Fast-fail uptime min 8 s, median 3212 s, max 230015 s, 5 under 120 s. Exit 1: 135 are ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND express + 4 agent-sdk (pre-09-29 deps loop, fixed by ensure_deps), 4 read ECONNRESET, the rest are our own kills; stack is already in sustain.log, so --report-uncaught-exception is not needed. sustain already gives Servex stdout+stderr (stdio [ignore,fd,fd]) and since 09-24 already launches with --report-on-fatalerror and Servex.initialize() sets the same: sustain.log shows NO stderr line before any of the 53 fast-fails and logs/reports/ holds one report (a 10-02 test). stamps in sustain.log are UTC.

decision.text: The brief's premise is falsified: a node fatal report cannot name this cause. Measured on this machine (node 24.15): process.abort() and a V8 OOM both exit 134 with a native stack on stderr and write the report; 3221226505 is neither, it has no stderr, no report, and no Windows Error Reporting event or CrashDump for node.exe (libuv sets SEM_NOGPFAULTERRORBOX, so WER stays silent for node while it logged lghub with the same 0xC0000409). So it is a silent native __fastfail (CRT invalid-parameter, a stack cookie or control-flow-guard check in native code), outside V8, and the report flags the brief asks for were already in place since 09-24 and have never fired. No Servex dependency has a .node addon. Correlation only: 4 of 49 crashes in lifecycle coverage have a lifecycle start/end event in the 2 s before (base rate 2%), 2 of the last 5 land at an agent/browser start; not conclusive. Therefore the fix is visibility plus breadcrumbs, not a code fix. Opus not warranted.
